The '''language''' of the [[Jastaal]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was composed of trilling, which formed its [[Language/Legends|phrases]].<ref name="HSR" /> At some point between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Han Solo Adventures]]'', of which ''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]'' is part, to between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].</ref> the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] noticed several Jastaal on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]] trilling phrases to each other while on the world investigating an [[Zlarb and Magg's enslavement ring|enslavement ring]].<ref name="HSR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The language appeared in ''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]'', a [[1979]] novel written by [[Brian Daley]] as the second volume of the ''[[Star Wars: The Han Solo Adventures]]'' trilogy.<ref name="HSR" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]'' {{1st}}
